translation.name: GOT WENG ABEM Alokso Abino Kalin

content: Kinim sikal afum ami sung uta ko.
Alo Yesus asiki tam kawed am unsa, kaw tam ayo ki kinim sikal afumlawsa mak teinbeno.
Kale wanang kinim madik ika kidela kin didaw ata bom Yesus Finuyámin am kadákal kinim sikal afum ayo tá daudomane, kale aka mafak keibane akumo, kale kanamsiw.
Yesus aka kinim sikal afumlawsa bakodaw, “tad as kom mit kadák tadále.” Aka kan todane,

Beta Yesus ayo wanang kinim dákadá bakoyam, “Finuyámin am be yaknámin uta abem, kukuw kidel fakuyámin uta bade kukuw mafak fakuyámin utane, bade kinim dakodawono kalin uta bade, kinim daw mafak dákamin utane?” Yaka, kata ika weng so mak bakodongin dakodiwe,

Yesus ayo aket keng keidawa dumade dumade wanang kinim itamansa. Kata aka kal keidomo, wanang kinim iyo yonin aket ki teinsa ka. Kale nadano kinkino, yakei nadane kinim ayo bakodaw, “kalam sikal uyo tufiyo!” Akane, sikal tufidomane, afan sikal kasái ka. Kalane,
Fedasi iyo yak nadiwe wabising Kamok Edot ami kinim so weng gudula dau anbidiw fikalako, kalesiw ko.
Wanang kinim seng seng iyo Yesus ibik tein unsiw sung uta ko.
Kale Yesus ayo kabadák bo kudá nadale alam weng kidimin kinim so iyo tad Galili wok mik badang tadiwe kanomin Galili kayak iyo abak so yán abo tasiw.

Kale wanang kinim seng imi abiw win so bakan win so uyo Yuddia kayak so Yedusalem kayak so Iddumiya kayak so wok Yoddan madik kayak so Taya abiw kayak so Saiddon abiw kayak so seng seng iyo Yesus ami kukuw kanam kába weng uyo adik kidi nadiwe tad atamsiw ko.
Aka alam weng kidimin kinim bakoyam, “kunu mak kidela dawti sidiw asadayono.” Kalesa uyo watawo kaleyo bá, wanang kinim abák so kayo tad bom adik falfalnamak modoliw, kale nadano kale bakosa.
Ade wanang kinim imi tad falfal dawkansiw. Be watawo kaleyo bá, aka wanang kinim seng kuw tá imkan badano kayo asanin kudusiw iyo naknek naknek tad malalaw bom kidelumo, kale nadiwo tademsiw.
Kale yak sinik mafak kiwsa iyo yak Yesus atam nadiwade ika alam kin gubuyo kal kutin dák abe nadiwe weng kufo bakodiw, “kaba Got ami Man.” Kal bidiwe,
aka atin weng anuyam nadale bako, “kiba bako aka kanodin kinimo kalin báno.” Yakeisa ko.
Yesus weng dew kámin kinim kilung kal walusa sung uta ko.
Beta Yesus ayo tam amgu dim nadale yak alam aket bidita ken walulokabi yakba kinim iyo gán dáyama tadiwe,
aka kinim kilung kal kuw walu nadane win takuyam, ‘weng dew kámin kinim.’ Yakeisa. Kale aka be kano walu imudino, kata nalaso bom nadiwe imadáli Got weng sawa bakayam ká bom nadiwe
kitid kudu sinik mafak mafak iyo fotaba bom keimin kala kale nadano ko.
Kale kinim kilung kal walusa bidi, kinim mak win Saimon, kata Yesus alata alokso win mak takudaw Bita, akeisa
keida, Sebeddi muduw Yemis so alam ning Yon so bidi Yesus alata win takuyam Bonedyas, yakeisa. Umi mit ayo kimán man kalin keidiw,
wáw Andadu, Filiw, Batalomu, Matiyu, Tomas, Alfias man Yemis, Taddiyas, Saimon bakan kalan ginanin kinim,
ade Yuddas Iskadiyat kayak ata Yesus gi dauyamsa kinim keida ita ko.
Yu kayak madik bako, Yesus be sinik mafak sono aksiw sung uta ko.

Kale Yesus so alam weng kidimin kinim so ika amgu kudá tad abiw abe tam am mak tam unane, wanang kinim iyo abák so tad falal daudiwade, alam weng kidimin kinim so nikil abin tein wanin wanodiw banim kei bidiwo,
alam aulal iyo ami sung adikum uyo kidi nadiwe yak dew tadumo, kale tasidiw. Be watawo kaleyo bá, ika bako nadiwe, “aka gebom mafaklaw badano sák yuwa kei kábano.” Ak bidiwo kayo ko.
Sawa kukumin kinim madik mak Yedusalem kaw tam kalo tad bako nadiwe, “Yesus be Mafakim kiwsa kayo Mafakim Biyelsabaw am win tudow dim sinik mafak ayo fotabano.” Kaliwe,
aka gán dáyama tad atamiwe, aka weng fakom weng bakoyam, “yakno yakno keiyo Mafakim tabe Mafakim fota bomane?
Kasák gu makuw ulumi ki tako dau wasi keida keida iw namti, kasák gu be ken bomu banim.
Ade am makuw kasel ilita ki tako dau wasi keida keida iw namti, ika ken dek amki bodiw banim.
Ade Mafakim alata tabe Mafakim tako dau ginanokaba kaí, aka ken tod boma banim ade alam teinámin uyo mafakokabu.

Kata yaknodin kinim tade tam kinim kitid kuw tabesa am uyo tam ami ufek ufek uyo ken yakot mak wanono, kalokaba ayo kamakakiw kinim kitid ayo sok gei dawti nadayo beta tam ami am ufek ufek uyo yakot wanako.
Bela kidilin, Got aka ken wanang kinim ban keimin so weng ididilawin so bu adikum lukuwá kudáyamoma,
kata kan ata Sinik Abem weng ididilawába namti, atin bu lukuwá kudáloma banim, watawo kaleyo bá, am weng Sinik Abem bakadaba be atin ban keimin dukum keiba ade ulum kanom sun biyámin ban keida make.
Kale Yesus kanamin weng bakose ayo watawo kaleyo bá, ika bakodaw nadiwe aka sinik mafak so gei dausano, akiwo buta kanamin weng uyo bakayamsa ko.
Yesus akun so alam nikil so imi sung uta ko.
Kaleyo bude Yesus akun so nikil so iyo tad abiw kaw tam tod nadiwe kinim mak dabadáliwe, ata tam
wanang kinim seng seng tein falala daubiw bakoyamane, ita ta bom Yesus bakodaw, “kam kakun so nikil so iyo tad abiw katamumo kale fenbiwo.” Akiwe,
aka bakoyam, “nami nein so nikil so bidi kan itane?”
Kale nadane aka kanomin wanang kinim tad am teinbiw itam nadale aka bakoyam, “kinim bidita nam neiniw kasal ade nam nikil.
Kale yak kan kawta Got alam aket fukanin ki dudew tabesaw namti, kiwta nam neiniw kasal ade nam wanangal ade nam nikil ka.” Kalesa ko.
